note: Every frame is one v2c decision bar: entry_condition / exit_condition are StrategyKernel._condition on that frame's history (position/cooldown gating belongs to the consumer), feature_values are the build_frames values as cutie.decimal128.v1 canonical strings. Frames are columnar: every list in `frames` (frame_close_at, entry_condition, exit_condition and each feature_values[key]) is aligned by frame index. exit_condition is false throughout because the matrix specs exit by time_exit_bars with signal_exit null. The synthetic market data is deterministic; see `generator`. sha256 = canonical_json_sha256({market_data, cases}).

generator.price_series: 24h shape (16 up, spike, 5 down of -6, 2 flat) + 4-point alternating daily drift + LCG(seed) hourly jitter in [-1, 1]
